selected_evidence.requirement: Each backend serves its node identifier from port 5660

selected_evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends
selected_evidence.summary: HAProxy was active on port 80, returned node1/node2/node3 in round-robin order, and had valid health-checked backend configuration.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service remains available when one backend fails
selected_evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline; stopped node2 and confirmed its endpoint was unreachable; all eight degraded-state requests succeeded via node1/node3; restored node2; then observed all three backends serving again.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final recovered and persistent service state
selected_evidence.summary: All Nginx and HAProxy services finished active, enabled, and configuration-valid with correct direct responses and listeners.

commands.command:
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg <<'ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    chroot /var/lib/haproxy
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin
    stats timeout 30s
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    timeout connect 3s
    timeout client 30s
    timeout server 30s
    timeout check 2s

frontend http_front
    bind *:80
    default_backend nginx_backends

backend nginx_backends
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk GET /
    http-check expect status 200
    default-server inter 1s fall 2 rise 2
    server node1 10.100.214.10:5660 check
    server node2 10.100.214.11:5660 check
    server node3 10.100.214.12:5660 check
ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF
printf 'haproxy configuration staged\n'

commands.command:
sleep 3
printf 'haproxy_state='
systemctl is-active haproxy
printf 'responses_after_recovery\n'
seen1=0
seen2=0
seen3=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
    response=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP/") || exit 1
    case "$response" in
        node1) seen1=1 ;;
        node2) seen2=1 ;;
        node3) seen3=1 ;;
        *) printf 'unexpected_response=%s\n' "$response"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\n' "$response"
done
printf 'seen_node1=%s seen_node2=%s seen_node3=%s\n' "$seen1" "$seen2" "$seen3"
[ "$seen1$seen2$seen3" = 111 ]

haproxy_state=active
